exercises.title: Type Registration
exercises.description: Register a custom Python type for use in QML using qmlRegisterType

exercises.title: Context Property Exposure
exercises.description: Expose a Python object to QML via setContextProperty and use it in QML

exercises.title: Bidirectional Data Binding
exercises.description: Create a property that can be read and written from both Python and QML

exercises.title: Type Conversion
exercises.description: Implement a slot that accepts a QML list and returns a QVariantMap

extra_exercises.title: QML Component Lifecycle
extra_exercises.description: Create a component that tracks its lifecycle (Component.onCompleted, Component.onDestruction)

extra_exercises.title: Dynamic Type Creation
extra_exercises.description: Use Qt.createComponent and createObject to dynamically create QML objects from Python data
